overview_description.description: With the 1Degree app, you can instantly FaceTime with amazing people from around the world!  Your followers on the app will receive a push notification when you signal your willingness and availability to connect. Either create a live auction and watch your fans bid against one another for the opportunity to FaceTime with you or set your availability and simply sit back, relax and review the FaceTime offers from your fans.  And Voila, you’re instantly chatting face-to-face with one of your fans from around the world. After your chat, you can choose to keep or easily donate your proceeds to your favorite cause.
